title: About BettaFish.website
description: Learn why BettaFish.website is being built, how its guidance is organized and which claims require specialist review.
h1: A clearer path through betta care
intro: BettaFish.website is an independent educational project designed to make betta husbandry easier to understand without turning every symptom into a diagnosis or every question into a product list.

sections.heading: Why this site exists
paragraphs: Betta advice is often fragmented: tank setup is separated from water quality, behaviour is mistaken for disease and health pages may offer treatment before checking the environment.
This site organizes guidance around keeper decisions and clear page roles. Each page states what it covers, what belongs elsewhere and what the reader should do next.

sections.heading: How we build trust
paragraphs: Sources, review requirements, content dates and corrections are treated as page data rather than decorative badges.

Research and writing are led by Farrukh Abdullah. Kate Barrington reviews and edits assigned guides. Robert Martinez, DVM, is assigned to clinically review disease and fish-health content. A clinical-review credit appears only after approval of the exact corrected version is recorded.
